prompt.text:
Implement `validateAccessRequest(input)`. `input` must be a non-null, non-array object; otherwise throw `TypeError`. It must contain string fields `displayName`, `department`, `location`, `phone`, `email`, `pin`, and `pinConfirmation`. Missing or non-string fields are treated as empty. Trim every field before validation. Required fields cannot be empty. A non-empty phone must contain exactly ten ASCII digits. A non-empty email must contain exactly one `@`, with non-empty text on both sides and no whitespace. A non-empty PIN must be exactly six characters and contain at least one ASCII letter and one digit. `pinConfirmation` must equal the trimmed PIN. Return `{ ok, errors, value }`. `errors` is a new object whose keys follow the field order above and whose values are one of `required`, `invalid phone`, `invalid email`, `invalid pin`, or `does not match`. `value` is `null` when invalid; otherwise it is a new object containing the trimmed fields except `pinConfirmation`. Do not mutate or alias `input`. Export exactly `{ validateAccessRequest }` using `module.exports`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
